messages:
emily: Heads-up: external pen test for staging next Wed. Proposing 10:00-13:00 PDT corridor. They request encrypt/decrypt on one test KMS key + assume-role. Any blockers?

raj: OK. Confirm if decrypt is required or if encrypt-only suffices?

katie: They asked for both. We should give a single test key, ephemeral role, and deny key policy edits. TTL 1h. I can own issuance.

infra: We'll land a small terraform change to create role and IP whitelist. Tester example:
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::444444:role/pt-stager --role-session-name pt --duration-seconds 3600

ops-bot: scheduled: CloudTrail export to s3://secure-audit/staging/pt-2111112222 at 13:05 PDT (immutable 90d).

emily: Good. Evidence checklist: CloudTrail events (kms, assume-role), VPC flow logs, app traces. Attach per-finding tickets labeled "pt-scan".

katie: Retest plan: vendor to re-run targeted tests within 3 business days after fix verification; book 2h retest slots.

raj: Set alarms: >40 kms:Decrypt calls/min from one principal -> notify; page only on critical threshold.

emily: Action items:
- infra: terraform role + IP whitelist (PR Tue EOD)
- katie: issue ephemeral creds and obs checklist (Wed)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm export & retention (Wed)
- raj: triage board + ticket templates

emily: If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock schedule. :thumbsup:
